import MumfordLib.GroupCohomologyAlternationInjective
import MumfordLib.GroupCohomologyAlternationSurjective

/-!
# The lattice group-cohomology alternation isomorphism

For a finite free abelian group, alternation identifies actual integral group
H2 with alternating two-forms, and hence with the exterior square of the dual.
The isomorphism sends character cup classes to wedges. Injectivity uses the
algebraic splitting of symmetric cocycles; surjectivity uses character cups.

This proves the alternation assertion of Mumford, *Abelian Varieties*,
Chapter I, pp. 16-17, by an algebraic argument. It does not identify a
group-to-singular cochain comparison.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {U : Type} [AddCommGroup U] [Module.Free ℤ U] [Module.Finite ℤ U]

/-- Alternation is an isomorphism on the second cohomology of a lattice. -/
def groupSecondCohomologyAlternationEquiv :
    groupCohomology.H2 (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ) ≃ₗ[ℤ]
      AlternatingMap ℤ U ℤ (Fin 2) :=
  LinearEquiv.ofBijective groupSecondCohomologyAlternation
    ⟨groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_injective,
      groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_surjective⟩

@[simp]
theorem groupSecondCohomologyAlternationEquiv_apply
    (x : groupCohomology.H2 (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ)) :
    groupSecondCohomologyAlternationEquiv x = groupSecondCohomologyAlternation x := rfl

/-- The exterior-square form of the lattice group-cohomology isomorphism. -/
def groupSecondCohomologyExteriorEquiv :
    groupCohomology.H2 (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ) ≃ₗ[ℤ]
      ⋀[ℤ]^2 (Module.Dual ℤ U) := by
  letI : Module ℤ (⋀[ℤ]^2 (Module.Dual ℤ U)) :=
    (⋀[ℤ]^2 (Module.Dual ℤ U)).module
  exact groupSecondCohomologyAlternationEquiv.trans
    (exteriorPowerDualAlternatingEquiv ℤ U 2).symm

@[simp]
theorem groupSecondCohomologyExteriorEquiv_groupCharacterCupClass
    (f g : Module.Dual ℤ U) :
    groupSecondCohomologyExteriorEquiv
      (groupCharacterCupClass f.toAddMonoidHom g.toAddMonoidHom) =
        exteriorPower.ιMulti ℤ 2 ![f, g] := by
  letI : Module ℤ (⋀[ℤ]^2 (Module.Dual ℤ U)) :=
    (⋀[ℤ]^2 (Module.Dual ℤ U)).module
  apply (exteriorPowerDualAlternatingEquiv ℤ U 2).injective
  change (exteriorPowerDualAlternatingEquiv ℤ U 2)
      ((exteriorPowerDualAlternatingEquiv ℤ U 2).symm
        (groupSecondCohomologyAlternation
          (groupCharacterCupClass f.toAddMonoidHom g.toAddMonoidHom))) = _
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  ext v
  rw [groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_groupCharacterCupClass,
    exteriorPowerDualAlternatingEquiv_ιMulti]
  simp [Matrix.det_fin_two, mul_comm]

/-- Every group H2 class is generated by degree-one character cups. -/
theorem groupCharacterCupClass_span :
    Submodule.span ℤ
      (Set.range (fun fg : (U →+ ℤ) × (U →+ ℤ) =>
        groupCharacterCupClass fg.1 fg.2)) = ⊤ := by
  letI : Module ℤ (⋀[ℤ]^2 (Module.Dual ℤ U)) :=
    (⋀[ℤ]^2 (Module.Dual ℤ U)).module
  let S := Submodule.span ℤ
    (Set.range (fun fg : (U →+ ℤ) × (U →+ ℤ) =>
      groupCharacterCupClass fg.1 fg.2))
  have htop : (⊤ : Submodule ℤ (⋀[ℤ]^2 (Module.Dual ℤ U))) ≤
      S.comap (groupSecondCohomologyExteriorEquiv (U := U)).symm.toLinearMap := by
    rw [← exteriorPower.ιMulti_span ℤ 2 (Module.Dual ℤ U)]
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨f, rfl⟩
    change (groupSecondCohomologyExteriorEquiv (U := U)).symm
      (exteriorPower.ιMulti ℤ 2 f) ∈ S
    have hf : f = ![f 0, f 1] := by ext i; fin_cases i <;> rfl
    rw [hf, ← groupSecondCohomologyExteriorEquiv_groupCharacterCupClass,
      LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨(f 0).toAddMonoidHom, (f 1).toAddMonoidHom⟩, rfl⟩
  apply top_unique
  intro x _
  have h := htop (Submodule.mem_top :
    groupSecondCohomologyExteriorEquiv (U := U) x ∈ ⊤)
  change (groupSecondCohomologyExteriorEquiv (U := U)).symm
    (groupSecondCohomologyExteriorEquiv x) ∈ S at h
  simpa only [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using h

end Mumford.Analytic
